Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
1) Does Alvaro, Scion of Angelica REALLY gain two blood if he is in
torpor during a political action? Can you explain this?
2) Can Mariel, Lady Thunder use her ability in torpor? (I guess she
can, so I need only "yes" or "no" answer)
3) Political Struggle text states: "If the vampire with this card is
burned or sent into torpor..." Does it work when the vampire is burned
or torporized by another player? Does it REALLY works when its owner is
ousted?

Thanks in advance,
Ector

Messages.Author: kamel...@yvelines.pref.gouv.fr
Messages.Body:
Ector wrote:
> 1) Does Alvaro, Scion of Angelica REALLY gain two blood if he is in
> torpor during a political action? Can you explain this?

Yes. Abstain is not giving his vote in favor or against a referendum.
When you're in torpor, you cannot giving your vote. Technically, every
vamp in torpor abstain. Including Alvaro, triggering his abilities.

> 2) Can Mariel, Lady Thunder use her ability in torpor? (I guess she
> can, so I need only "yes" or "no" answer)

Yes.

> 3) Political Struggle text states: "If the vampire with this card is
> burned or sent into torpor..." Does it work when the vampire is
burned
> or torporized by another player?

yes.

>Does it REALLY works when its owner is
> ousted?

Yes. All cards controled by an ousted player are burned, including his
vamp, triggering the political struggle, before it burns itself.
Correction of your question : political seizure does noes triggers if
the "owner" of the vamp is ousted, but the "controler" of the vamp (see
online rulebook for the difference between controler and owner : for
example : political struggle is owned by the meth who have it in his
deck, and controled by the controler of the vamp it is put on).
> Thanks in advance,
> Ector
No problem,
Bye.
Kamel Senni.
